scores.rationale: The candidate implements the `accumulateUsage` helper in `chatOrchestrator.ts` identically to the reference and thoroughly tests multi-round accumulation and `undefined` handling. However, it completely misses the acceptance criterion requiring the hook's type signature to make the sum unambiguous: the reference renamed the parameter to `totalUsage` (and the local variable from `lastUsage` to `totalUsage`), whereas the candidate left `OrchestratorHooks` untouched and kept the misleading `lastUsage` local name. Additionally, the candidate extracted `scriptedProvider` into a non-test source file (`src/orchestration/scripted-provider-helper.ts`), added a separate acceptance test file instead of keeping all tests in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and inadvertently flipped the status of `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` from `Shipped` back to `In Progress`.
